experiment_name: BR-2: multiple whole answers generated together, genius weights reason over them and refine into ONE answer (user directive)
user_theory: (a) generate multiple ANSWERS together (not one token at a time - whole answers); (b) mix genius weights with the model's normal weights so both hold context together; (c) genius reasons over the candidate answers and refines them into one final answer. Win condition: accuracy goes UP (not down) vs single-answer baseline.

parent_results.prompt: identical digit-dense prompt as BR-1 (br1_eval.py user_content, exemplars train 0,1 digit-dense)

design_rationale.interpretation_of_mixing: genius heads are 896->12 classifiers over the frozen token universe U (digits/newline/eos); the model lm_head is 896->151936. Literal addition into lm_head is undefined for 151,924 tokens genius never saw, so 'mixing' is implemented at two frozen, disclosed levels: (L1) decision-level mix - final answer = weighted vote where each candidate's weight s = beta*genius_score + (1-beta)*model_score (beta=0.5: both signals hold equal weight = 'equal amount of context'); (L2) generation-level mix (arm M4) - genius logits are literally ADDED into model logits at confident steps. Full-vocab genius heads would need a ~550MB closed-form compile (897x151936) - deferred, disclosed.
design_rationale.why_scoring_is_free: during generation every step already computes h_t and logits; genius z-scores are one 896x12 matmul per step (~67k flops, negligible). No extra forwards.

arms_frozen.M0_baseline: single greedy answer - REUSED from BR-1 arm A (bit-identical prompt/model/op-order; state realbench_cache/br1_eval/state_A.json sha256 49aeacc646f3969eecec2792838b6d8ac157cf012f09349bc59a05520dd3a940->recomputed at assemble; no rerun, disclosed as reuse)
arms_frozen.MGEN_shared_candidates: per item, K=4 whole answers generated with the SAME BR-1 prompt: cand 0 = greedy; cand 1..3 = sampled with temperature T=0.7, pure temperature (no top-k/top-p), torch.Generator(cpu).manual_seed(1000003 + idx*7919 + cand). max_new=384, fp32, threads=2. For every generated token y_t at answer position: record (a) genius H1 prob of y_t = softmax(W0 h + b0)[y_t] over U (skip non-U tokens), (b) model logprob of y_t under full-vocab log_softmax. Per candidate: genius_score = mean of (a) (0.0 if no U tokens), model_score = mean of (b), pred = extract_ans (#### first, else last number, same regex as BR-1), n_tokens, wall_s. Candidates checkpointed per-candidate for slice resume.
arms_frozen.M1_primary: genius+model mixed refinement (beta=0.5): min-max normalize genius_score and model_score within the item's non-abstaining candidates; s_i = 0.5*gn_i + 0.5*lp_i; group candidates by pred value; group weight = sum of s_i; winner = argmax group weight; ties -> group containing max s_i -> then lower numeric value; final pred = winner group's value; abstain (all None) = wrong
arms_frozen.M2_control: pure self-consistency: majority vote by count among non-abstaining candidates; ties -> higher mean model_score -> lower value; isolates what the genius signal adds beyond voting
arms_frozen.M3_diagnostic: genius-only refinement (beta=1.0): same rule as M1 with s_i = gn_i; shows whether genius alone can refine
arms_frozen.M4_generation_mix: literal weight-mixing during generation: at each step, if genius H1 softmax max-conf >= tau_1 (0.938 from BR-1 heads), next token = argmax over U of ( z_model[U] + 2.0 * standardized z1 ) else next = argmax full-vocab z_model; gamma=2.0 frozen (arbitrary but fixed, disclosed); greedy-style, 1 answer per item

eval_protocol_frozen.items: GSM8K test indices [7+43*k for k in 0..29] (same 30 as C1/BR-1); strict = extracted value == gold, abstention counts wrong
eval_protocol_frozen.primary_metric: strict accuracy of M1 vs M0 on the 30 items
eval_protocol_frozen.secondary: M2/M3/M4 strict; wall-clock per item per arm; effective tok/s (total generated tokens across candidates / wall)

hypotheses_bands_frozen.H_B_genius_adds: M1 - M2: >= +1 item (+3.3pp) genius adds value; +/-0 items neutral; <= -1 item genius hurts
hypotheses_bands_frozen.H_C_cost: MGEN wall per item reported honestly; no success gate (CPU has no true parallelism; wall = 4 serial generations)
hypotheses_bands_frozen.H_D_theory: user theory WORKS iff H_A SUCCESS and H_B not hurt; PARTIAL iff H_A PARTIAL; FAILS otherwise
